article.headline: 5Color Bicycle Helmet Recall: Size Small, 324 Units — Stop Use Immediately

research.facts:
5Color Bicycle Helmet Recall
**Source:** CPSC.gov recall notice, September 24, 2026
**Confidence:** HIGH (direct CPSC primary source)
- Product: 5Color bicycle helmets, size Small, pink
- Units recalled: approximately 324
- Model: YD-001
- Lot number: YD-260320
- Head circumference fit: 18–22 inches
- Sale channel: Amazon, May 2026
- Price: approximately $25–$26
- Hazard: Violates CPSC mandatory safety standards for bicycle helmets (federal requirements)
- Consumer action: Stop use immediately; cut the straps; email a photo to FiveColorCS@163.com for refund information
- Contact: 833-382-6461, Monday–Friday, 9 AM–2 PM CT
- Injuries/incidents: None reported (at time of recall)
- cpsc.gov recall page confirmed Sep 24, 2026

article.headline: AAP Recommends 2026-2027 COVID-19 Vaccine for All Children 6 Months Through 18 Years

research.facts:
AAP 2026-2027 COVID-19 Vaccine Recommendations
**Sources:**
- AAP Pediatrics journal: peds.2026-079045 (2026-2027 COVID-19 vaccine guidance)
- Contemporary Pediatrics coverage of AAP statement
- AAP News: "AAP continues to recommend COVID-19 vaccines for children who are young or high-risk"
- AAP Pediatrics journal: e2025075754 (2026 immunization schedule)
**Confidence:** HIGH (peer-reviewed journal, AAP primary source)
- AAP recommends all infants and children ages 6–23 months receive the 2026-2027 COVID-19 vaccine
- Children ages 2–18: single dose of the age-appropriate 2026-27 vaccine, regardless of prior vaccination history
- New 2026 immunization schedule: clesrovimab added for RSV immunizations; HPV vaccine age range updated to 9–12 years
- Policy statement published in Pediatrics journal
- Recommendation applies to all children without contraindications

article.headline: Two Fall Events for Colorado Springs Families: Gather Mountain Blooms Oktoberfest and the Coffin Races

research.facts:
Fall Family Events — Gather Mountain Blooms + Coffin Races
**Sources:** gathermountainblooms.com; visitcos.com; eventeny.com; manitousprings.org; fox21news.com; gazette.com (Jun 9, 2026); KRDO (Jun 9 + Jul 22, 2026)
**Confidence:** HIGH (direct venue/event websites + multiple news sources)
**Gather Mountain Blooms Oktoberfest:**
- Dates: October 3–4, 2026, 10 AM–6 PM
- Location: 5210 S. U.S. Hwy 85-87, Colorado Springs, CO 80911
- Admission: $8 general admission; $40 GA + limited-edition beer stein; FREE for children 3 and under
- Activities: flower fields, pumpkin picking, hayrides, kids games, artisan makers market, local food trucks, biergarten (local craft beers), authentic German food
research.sources:
- Source: gathermountainblooms.com, visitcos.com
**Emma Crawford Coffin Races:**
- Date: Saturday, October 24, 2026
- Location: Manitou Avenue, Downtown Manitou Springs
- 32nd annual event
- Format: teams of 5 (one "Emma" + four runners) race decorated coffins down Manitou Avenue in costume
- Attendance: approximately 10,000 people
- Team entry fee: $100; registration deadline midnight October 22
- Registration: Visit Manitou Springs, 354 Manitou Ave, Manitou Springs CO 80829
- Status: CONFIRMED to proceed — Manitou Springs City Council voted June 9 to proceed; 25 officers (15 Colorado Rangers, $9,600); new Manitou Event Ambassador volunteer program launching
- Prior concern: Spring 2026 Gazette reported possible cancellation due to security costs; resolved Jun 9
- Sources: eventeny.com, manitousprings.org, fox21news.com, gazette.com Jun 9 2026, KRDO Jun 9 + Jul 22 2026
